description: This file is a shell script containing a series of test cases for verifying support for reading configuration data from a blob in a version control system, likely Git. It sets up test scenarios, performs commands, and checks expected outputs related to reading, writing, and error conditions involving config blobs.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful execution

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern in output

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit with specific content

methods.name: nongit
methods.description: Runs a command outside of a Git repository context
